statement.label: PIM.1.5#01
statement.requirement: IF the user can enter personal health information into the system THEN the system SHALL clearly disclose whether data validity checking is performed, and SHALL document or reference the evidence for that validity checking.

statement.label: PIM.1.5#02
statement.requirement: IF the system collects or receives quantitative data THEN the system SHALL document and justify the precision, that is the accuracy and granularity, of measurements such as physical activity or physiological data from connected devices, as appropriate for its intended use.

statement.label: PIM.1.5#03
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI functionality THEN the system SHALL maintain technical documentation sufficient for an assessor to determine the AI function's model or service type, version, intended use, input data categories, output types, data transformations, dependency services, and known operational constraints.

statement.label: PIM.1.5#04
statement.requirement: IF AI output is derived from health data THEN the system SHALL document the data-quality checks, missing-data behavior, input validity constraints, and known measurement or transcription limitations that can affect the AI output.

statement.label: PIM.1.5#05
statement.requirement: IF the system hosts personal health information THEN the system SHALL document backup and recovery procedures that comply with applicable regulatory requirements.

statement.label: PIM.1.5#06
statement.requirement: IF personal health data are imported into or exported from the system THEN the system SHALL document its data import and export functions, including the ability to convert to standard formats.

statement.label: PIM.1.5#07
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI functionality THEN the system SHOULD make a consumer-accessible technical summary or model card available without requiring disclosure of proprietary source code or trade secrets.
